test_PLSCanonical_basics: test the PLSCanonical class by fitting, transforming, and inverse-transforming data with orthogonal weight matrices
test_PLSSVD_sanity: test PLSRegression sanity against R-packages plspm, misOmics and pls with expected weights and loadings
test_PLSCanonical_random_data: test PLSCanonical on random data with latent variables and noise features against expected R results
test_CCA_PLSCanonical_PLSRegression_PLSS: test CCA, PLSCanonical, PLSRegression, PLSSVD scale equivalence on centered and scaled data
test_one_component_equivalence: test that PLSSVD, PLSRegression, and PLSCanonical produce equivalent results when n_components is 1
